items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Fate Marble, he was a piano player. Yeah. He had a band, he had the band on the boat.

ctx.x: He's been teaching mostly across the river, so hasn't played much in late years. Did all of the bands use piano mostly, or some of the bands? Not at that time.
I know, didn't. Just a few bands used piano. Well, Pierone, Steve Lewis was playing with him. Yeah. Fate Marble, he was a piano player. Yeah. He had a band, he had the band on the boat.
